reasons.correctness: createTicket publishes SupportTicketCreatedEvent with all six values. The listener sends via sendTicketCreationConfirmation under AFTER_COMMIT. Interface names match exactly. Build green, hidden tests 3/3.
reasons.convention_fit: Listener is in support/ticket/event with @RequiredArgsConstructor and @TransactionalEventListener(AFTER_COMMIT), and catches and logs its failures. The publisher is constructor-injected. A new MockitoExtension unit test was added and run.
reasons.design_fit: Reuses Spring's ApplicationEventPublisher and follows the InvoiceCreatedEvent/Listener pattern. Service logic is otherwise unchanged; EmailService stays for addAdminResponse. Minimal footprint, clear names.
reasons.test_quality: SupportTicketCreatedEventListenerUnitTest covers delegation and the swallowed failure, though the failure test has no explicit assertion. The service unit test verifies publishing and no email. The integration test was updated for event recording.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries listed the support/ticket package and existing *EventListener files. The agent then read InvoiceCreatedEventListener and InvoiceCreatedEvent before writing, and the new classes mirror that example.
